title: D-SP-4 Stage 2a: exempt bearer-authenticated loopback callers from the per-IP rate limit on 9093 and 9091
goal: Requests from a loopback peer that present this host's own api token are not metered by the per-IP rate limiter on GMCP (9090/9093) and the OpenAI-compatible port (9091), so the thin CLI cannot hit 429 on its own daemon; peer-bearer, signed, remote, wrong-token and no-token callers stay metered.
